name: Pony Package Screen-Wheel Constraint
formation: Gun Pony Split Backs (RB1 Left, RB2 Right)

summary.motive: Exploit defenses overreacting to quick perimeter screen calls by pairing dual-back Pony personnel with a fake screen left and a devastating rail wheel right.
summary.keyDefender: Apex Nickel / Strong Safety (Boundary Flat & Deep Half Defenders)
summary.whyItWorks: The aggressive pump-fake and two-man offensive lineman convoy pulls all second-level defenders to the left, leaving the entire right sideline completely abandoned for the second running back.
summary.failureMode: Edge rusher RDE beating the RT quickly off the edge before the QB can pivot and reset to throw the wheel.

beats.title: 1. The Pony Split-Back Mesh & Flash Screen
beats.text: From the dual-back Pony set, RB1 blazes out on a high-speed swing screen left with LT and LG releasing in convoy. QB executes an emphatic pump fake left.

beats.title: 2. Defensive Overpursuit & Boundary Vacuum
beats.text: The defense bites hard on the screen threat: Will, Mike, LCB, and Free Safety all sprint toward the left sideline to tackle RB1 behind the line.

beats.title: 3. The Inside-Out Wheel Release
beats.text: RB2 feigns an interior lead block, then snaps violently outside the right tackle into a full-speed rail wheel down the vacated right sideline. Z’s dig route pulls the RCB inside.

beats.title: 4. Precision Drop Down the Sideline
beats.text: QB resets, squares his shoulders, and drops a 28-yard rainbow right into RB2’s breadbasket for an explosive runaway touchdown down the right sideline.

relations.tell: Shotgun Pony split-back alignment with QB pump-faking to the swing before resetting his feet to the opposite boundary.
